name: diconium / Embitel Technologies (India) Pvt. Ltd.
verified_facts: Embitel Technologies is a 100% Volkswagen Group company since 2022 (embitel.com/about-us).
Embitel remains a subsidiary of the diconium group, and thus part of Volkswagen Group Sales IT (embitel.com press archives; About page names diconium Group CEO Jasmin Eichler).
diconium is itself a 100% Volkswagen Group company, originally acquired in stages: 49% Nov 2018, remaining 51% announced Jan 2020 (volkswagen-group.com press release).
Embitel has its corporate office in Bengaluru, with development centres in Ahmedabad, Pune and Coimbatore (EMbitel/PRNewswire Dec 2024 release).

CARIAD India is a dedicated Business Unit of Embitel operating as a GCC for CARIAD, contributing directly to Volkswagen Group's global vehicle platforms; the rebranding does not change Embitel's legal entity or ownership (embitel.com About page and July 2025 press note, ~400-member team).
Embitel works across automotive, embedded systems, connected mobility, digital transformation, vehicle connectivity, ADAS, Cloud & Connectivity, Infotainment, Data & AI (embitel.com/about-us).

diconium's core competence includes e-commerce / digital sales solutions: it developed Volkswagen's global online sales platform for digital services and on-demand vehicle functions (VW press release 2020; diconium.com About).
Embitel employs roughly 1,600 people with a Group-backed goal of 4,000 by 2030; ~30% of revenue comes from clients outside the VW ecosystem (ETGCC, June 2026).
Applications route through diconium's Workday tenant at diconium.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/Embitel_Technologies (posting source URL).
